data.name: Shadow: A Parable of Sappho
data.detailed_description:
Shadow: A Parable of Sappho is a short classic point-and-click adventure game that incorporates elements of poetry and history (which can also be played in one go!).

THE STORY

City of Mytilene, Lesbos. A plague is threatening all of Greece. The city's most beloved poet, Sappho, is summoned by the Seven Sages to Pittacus' house, the tyrant and also one of the Sages.

What at first seems like a humble evening that Sappho is to enliven with poetry and music will soon transform into a dark night where the heroine must negotiate with the Sages, get to know the people of Mytilene, and solve the mystery of the deadly plague that has plunged the city into horror and chaos.

Who is Pittacus, and what dark secret binds his past to our protagonist's future? 

Play as the Ancient Greek poet Sappho and comfort the plague-stricken population, speak with the gods, make sacrifices, and fight the mysterious shadows that whisper in your ear time and again that nothing is as it seems.

Your most powerful tool? Poetry!

FEATURES

  • A philosophical storyline with detective elements of Ancient Greece and its mythology.

  • Inspired by the short tale "Shadow: A Parable" by the horror writer Edgar Allan Poe.

  • Traditional point-and-click adventure game puzzles and interactions, with innovative mechanics based in Sapphic poetry.

  • Interact with historical, mythological, and political figures, Sappho's friends and lovers, and city inhabitants, all with their own personalities and stories.

  • An eerie tone, with surprises of drama, fantasy and horror.

  • Pixel art graphics in the style of classic adventure games and engaging animations.

  • An original soundtrack recorded with Mediterranean instruments.

data.short_description: Shadow: A Parable of Sappho is a narrative-driven gothic adventure set in Ancient Greece. Play as the famous poet Sappho of Lesbos: help the Seven Sages, comfort the population, speak with the Gods and fight the mysterious shadows that bring the deadly plague. Your most powerful tool? Poetry!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 3000 (OpenGL 3.3 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated GPU from 2015+
  • DirectX: Version 11
